title: Raw Imagery Impacting Your AI: Should You Care?
abstract: arXiv:2609.38265v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Onboard AI is gaining interest for space applications such as vessel, wildfire, and cloud detection, where real-time processing can improve mission reactivity and reduce downlink needs. However, onboard models may operate on raw or minimally processed imagery rather than on restored ground products. This study evaluates how image degradation affects object detection by varying Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR), Modulation Transfer Function (MTF) at Nyquist, and Ground Sampling Distance (GSD). Controlled degradations are applied to Very High Resolution Maxar imagery, and three lightweight detectors, YOLOv5s, YOLOX-S, and NanoDet, are evaluated on the resulting operating points. The results show that the impact of image quality depends on the degradation mechanism, and that increasing degradation does not necessarily lead to a proportional decrease in vessel detection performance. translated_title: 原始影像影响你的AI：你需要在意吗？
translated_abstract: 星载AI在空间应用领域（如船舶检测、野火检测和云检测）正受到越来越多关注，实时处理可以提高任务的响应能力并减少数据下行传输需求。然而，星载模型可能需要在原始或仅经过最小化处理的影像上运行，而不是在经过修复的地面产品上。本研究通过改变信噪比（SNR）、奈奎斯特频率处的调制传递函数（MTF）和地面采样距离（GSD），评估图像退化对目标检测的影响。研究对超高分辨率Maxar影像施加了受控退化，并在由此产生的各种工作点上评估了三个轻量级检测器：YOLOv5s、YOLOX-S和NanoDet。结果表明，图像质量的影响取决于具体的退化机制，且退化程度的增加并不一定导致船舶检测性能成比例下降。GSD产生最一致的性能变化，而MTF…
tldr: 本研究通过控制信噪比、调制传递函数和地面采样距离三类图像退化，评估了三个轻量级星载目标检测器在退化影像上的性能，发现退化对船舶检测的影响取决于退化机制，其中地面采样距离产生最一致的性能变化，且退化加剧未必导致性能成比例下降。
en_tdlr: This study evaluates three lightweight onboard detectors under controlled image degradations (SNR, MTF at Nyquist, and GSD) applied to VHR Maxar imagery, showing that degradation impact depends on the mechanism, with GSD producing the most consistent performance shifts and increased degradation not necessarily proportionally reducing vessel detection performance.
